## Cita general

::: {.cita}
Beltrán, Ulises, Rodrigo Castro Cornejo, Melina Altamirano y Matthew Singer (2024), Estudio Nacional Electoral de México (UMASS-CSES) 2024, Lowell: Center for Public Opinion / University of Massachusetts Lowell.
:::

**How to cite:**

::: {.cita}
Beltrán, Ulises, Rodrigo Castro Cornejo, Melina Altamirano, and Matthew Singer (2024), Mexican Election Study (UMASS-CSES) 2024, Lowell: Center for Public Opinion / University of Massachusetts Lowell.
:::
